verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a locally run, agent-driven video production tool, so webhooks for events such as job completion or review status are a fair question for it. The evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The post-video command publishes finished videos to social platforms, and the activity log and Production line tab are in-app views; neither is a webhook subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
